name: unit-cas
title: Unit CAS
description: Calculate with units, convert measurements, and solve equations using LaTeX or TI-Nspire syntax.
author: nosefa

commands.name: calculate
commands.title: Calculate
commands.description: Evaluate expressions with units, conversions and solve() — paste LaTeX or TI-Nspire text

commands.name: units
commands.title: Browse Units
commands.description: Browse the TI-Nspire units and physical constants

preferences.name: calcMode
preferences.title: Calculation Mode
preferences.description: Auto keeps integers and fractions exact unless a decimal is entered (like the Nspire's Auto mode)

preferences.name: angleMode
preferences.title: Angle Mode
preferences.description: Default unit for angles without an explicit angle unit. Switch it from the search bar dropdown or with ⌘⇧A while calculating.

preferences.name: nspireAscii
preferences.title: TI-Nspire Export
preferences.label: Use ASCII operators (@>, sqrt, <=) instead of ►, √, ≤
preferences.description: Plain ASCII is easier to type into the Nspire computer software by hand

preferences.name: renderMath
preferences.title: Math Preview
preferences.label: Render LaTeX in the detail pane
preferences.description: Typesets the input and result locally with MathJax
